messages:
nina: Hey all — planning my return after parental leave. Thinking 60% for 8 weeks starting 2026-08-03. Need quick confirms: benefits continuity, payroll code, equipment to work from home 2 days/week, and short-term coverage for code reviews weeks 1-3. Also would like a recurring lactation room slot Tue mornings.
people-ops: Congrats @nina! :tada: Please complete the Return/Phased form: https://hr.redwood.example/phased-return and select 60% 8w. That triggers payroll + benefits flows. Benefits remain active; premiums prorated.
michelle: Payroll note: use code PT60-2026 on the form so payroll applies the correct proration and subsidy adjustments. Equity vesting unchanged; compops will follow up by email.
omar: I can cover code reviews weeks 1-2 and pair with @recruiting for week 3 reviews. Nina, which days will you be remote so we can schedule syncs?
nina: Remote Tue/Thu, in-office Wed. Mon/Fri blocked for childcare.
recruiting: I'll spin up a 0.25 FTE 6-week contractor req today to help async reviews. Tagging people-ops for onboarding checklist. Candidate ETA ~10 days.
people-ops: Equipment: can ship a USB-C dock + 24" monitor. Add shipping address on the form. Standard ship ETA 6-9 business days; note "expedite" if needed.
nina: Do I need new FMLA paperwork for the phased return or does the original leave cover it? Don't want surprises.
people-ops: No new FMLA docs if the leave is continuous and the return plan is within the originally certified period. If dates/FTE change materially, we'll reach out.
michelle: Childcare subsidy is prorated to FTE (PT60-2026). I'll run an estimate and DM you before payroll posts.
nina: Lactation room: please reserve Tue 08:45-09:15 for 8 weeks if possible.
people-ops: Reserved Tue 08:45-09:15; invites sent.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit the phased-return form within 7 business days to guarantee equipment ships before start date.
nina: Submitted form and included address + PT60-2026 note. Thanks everyone!
people-ops: Checklist for nina: submit form (done), michelle to confirm subsidy calc, recruiting to post contractor req, omar to publish review rota, people-ops to confirm equipment ship date. We'll update this thread as items complete.
michelle: I'll post the subsidy calc in DM later today.
omar: I'll publish rota by EOD.
nina: Appreciate the help :heart:
